name: Mishma
overview: The name Mishma appears in Scripture as both a son of Ishmael and a descendant within the tribe of Simeon, illustrating the distinct lineages bearing this name. Genesis 25:14 and 1 Chronicles 1:30 identify Mishma among the sons of Ishmael, highlighting his place in the Abrahamic family tree. Meanwhile, 1 Chronicles 4:25-26 traces a Simeonite genealogy including Mishma and his sons, emphasizing the continuation of God's covenant people through diverse tribal lines.
